title: Agricultural holding register
description: Maintain agricultural production units and separately asserted holder responsibilities.

review.description: A distinct reviewer approves a fixed name correction. Approval leaves the record unchanged until the reviewer applies the frozen effect.

scopeNotes: A holding is a production unit; registration establishes neither land title nor benefit entitlement.
Readers see holdings only. Identity records and typed person, organization or informal-group holder responsibilities are restricted to editors and reviewers.
Holder responsibilities are separate assertions, including joint holders; they do not imply daily management or work.
